resolution: Fixed the core loop-cut bug exposed by the side-by-side: the cut must SPLIT the selected face (the face halves), so the cut axis is one of the face's two IN-PLANE axes — NOT its normal. I had wrongly 'corrected' it to the normal axis earlier (which slabbed toward the face and left it whole, the exact symptom: 'our face is still the exact same size'). loopCutAxisInfo now derives the two in-plane axes (excluding the face normal) and Direction 0/1 picks between them. Because an in-plane cut splits the selected face into two tagged pieces, added lcKeptFace to keep just the −side (lo-centroid) half as the selection + highlight, so the face visibly halves and shrinks as offset rises (matching 'I get the short end of the stick') instead of both halves re-covering it. Removed the now-moot fromHi mirroring. Preview highlight + Apply both use lcKeptFace; tag still rides through the cut so the selection persists onto the right half. editMesh 19/19; Studio bundle-clean; hot-reload TSX; nothing committed.
